summary.text: Lisa Beaudoin is the Democratic candidate for the New Hampshire House of Representatives, Merrimack 18, in the November 3, 2026 general election, after advancing from the Democratic primary on September 8, 2026.

paragraphs.text: Lisa Beaudoin was a Democratic candidate for the New Hampshire House of Representatives, Hillsborough 25, in the November 6, 2018 general election, in which Paul Somero and Tim Merlino won the district's two seats.
